text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(—I hear the cheers, and the ground 
rumbles.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Inside the story I yearned for that day, 
I—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sway...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Wah, whoa, even for an earthquake, isn't 
this shaking way too much...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wobble!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: E-E-E-Earthquake...!?
choice_data_list:
That wasn't an earthquake, it's the bus! 
We're here!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, eh, wha...!? Wh-Where... to...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry about earlier...! I 
completely fell asleep...
choice_data_list: No, sorry for waking you up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The season for the summer training camp 
has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy is also fully fired up for 
the Kikuka Sho— or so I'd like to say, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I... how should I put this...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I feel like I've got ‘Derby Brain’!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Every now and then, I suddenly 
recall the atmosphere of the Derby and get 
totally lost in it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about the Derby in bed in the 
middle of the night and not being able to 
sleep...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I ended up dozing off 
just like earlier, and even during that 
nap, I was dreaming about the Derby... 
Ngh!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, this might actually be pretty 
serious...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You're right, I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I really want to work even harder 
than usual during this training camp...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"We have the goal of winning the 
Kikuka-sho, and above all, I still have so 
much more—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—It is far too early to stand beside a 
"hero."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I have to build up my strength now to 
fight through the autumn races...! If I 
don't, I won't be able to stand on the 
stage of heroes...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why, um...! At this year's 
summer training camp, I'm gonna blow away 
my post-Derby daze—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I want you to make it strictly Spartan!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! I-I'll definitely 
make it through whatever training comes my 
way, so...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy herself was the one who 
asked for a spartan training camp— It 
seems she really is full of determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then as a Trainer, I have no choice but 
to give it my all! A blazing summer with 
Zenno Rob Roy begins now!"
